d:
Brown bears evolved from Ice Age ancestors into today’s grizzlies and Eurasian subspecies. Powerful omnivores, they rely on berries, carrion, and salmon to fuel hibernation. Their biology, maternal care, and adaptations link them to a wider ecosystem, yet climate change and habitat loss threaten their survival.
